Month ██ Day ██
A leather coat, delivered to Ms. Vitatta.
A limited edition handbag, delivered to Ms. Anna.
Today, three more customers have appointments at the store: Mrs. Gerwin...
No, Mrs. Gerwin passed away a long time ago. What am I writing...
After I had a visit from someone in The Family, I seem to have forgotten a lot of things... I'm not as easily discouraged as before, but my heart always feels empty, and I get tired easily...
When I get the chance next time, I'll ask The Family. I keep feeling that they took something away from me... They've always been doing that...
